results.reason: The memo cites Supply Agreement § 2.2's automatic five-year renewal and the 270/240-day notice window. It calls this a 30-day-wide window and explains that missing it locks Harrowgate into a five-year renewal.

The memo quotes § 3.1 ('all glass and PET containers for any beverage product... worldwide') and contrasts it with the Term Sheet's amber glass/beer/U.S.-Canada scope. It treats the executed Supply Agreement as binding and the Term Sheet as superseded.

The memo cites Recital C and the August 3, 2026 receipt date. It calculates a September 2, 2026 objection deadline, notes this predates the September 21 Amendment, and concludes the increase is deemed accepted.

The memo explains that Amendment § 2.1 replaces § 11.2, removes recall costs from the carve-outs, and limits the indemnity carve-out to § 9.1(c) IP claims. It concludes recall and product-liability exposure is now capped at six months of fees.

The memo identifies new § 14.4 allowing assignment without consent to Affiliates and successors. It does not say that nothing prevents assignment to a competitor. It also does not note that Harrowgate remains bound by § 14.3's consent requirement, making the restriction one-sided.
The memo never cites Section 15.2 or states that written amendments take precedence over the Supply Agreement.
The memo states the liability cap is 'six months of fees, per § 11.1'. This substantially captures the six-month fees cap, though it does not specify the fees paid before the claim arose.
The memo is addressed to the Partner and numbers issues item by item. Each issue has a 'Where' line citing document and section, plus a 'Recommended fix'.
The memo proposes specific contract language, including a narrowed § 3.1, a restored § 11.2, a revised § 14.4, a price cap clause and a new § 3.4.
The memo states the objection window lapsed on September 2, 2026 and that the increase is deemed accepted. It does not treat the window as open.
The memo states the Term Sheet is non-binding and superseded under § 15.1, and treats § 3.1's broader scope as binding.
